description: Adjust the quantity of a product offered for sale.
description_detail: Advertise available product supply to the external exchange to attract orders.
mode_confirmation: Use is_beer_game_mode and action_constraints from sales.json.policy_context, trade_decision_card.policy_context, or blackboard.policy_context_by_department.sales. In beer_game mode, this action releases a tradable quantity to downstream enterprises.
guidelines: For each product never previously offered through this action, post its product ID and available quantity promptly.
Call this action again in later rounds to update the quantity offered for the same product.
Available quantities change as procurement, production, and sales proceed.

Release less supply and protect existing commitments when service_level_summary.fill_rate is low, confirmed_order_backlog_quantity is high, stale_backlog_quantity is rising, or blackboard.inventory.policy_alerts shows finished-goods pressure.
Release supply more conservatively when trade_decision_card.delta.pressure_changes shows falling on_hand, rising backlog, or increasing due_risk for the product.
parameter_constraints: quantity must be nonnegative and must not exceed current inventory.
When confirmed_order_backlog_quantity, stale_backlog_quantity, or lost_sales_quantity is present, release conservatively without materially increasing fulfillment risk.
If trade_decision_card.review_queue contains a pending proposal for the same product, resolve it before increasing adjust_sales_demand.quantity.
Use service_level_summary as the canonical fulfillment input; do not double-count demand_backlog and service_level_summary.backlog_by_product.
When creating action.json from this template, action_param must contain exactly the fields listed in required_parameters, with none added or omitted.
Do not add explanatory or scheduling fields such as round_id, unit_price, price_per_unit, delivery_round_offset, delivery_deadline_offset, target_market, or reason.
